id.description: The passage id, the same as its file name without .yaml.

topic.description: The topic it answers (an id in kb/topics.yaml).

version.description: The passage's own version ("2026.1"), recorded with every answer.

locale.description: Its language tag. Default: the app's default locale under kb/passages, the folder's under kb/locale/<tag>/passages.

applies.description: Which callers it answers: for each fact in kb.yaml's applies, a value or a list of values. A fact left out means any value. Default: every caller.

from.description: The first day it is in force.

to.description: The last day it is in force (inclusive). Default: open-ended.

effective.description: The days it is in force, both inclusive.

document.description: The source document: a file name in kb/sources, without .yaml.

section.description: The section of that document the answer is drawn from (a key under its sections).

source.description: Where the answer comes from. Its text is hashed at approval.

answer.description: The approved answer, said word for word: fixed text with no variables, short enough to say in one breath.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 of the source section's text at approval (its words, whitespace collapsed). A changed source makes the passage stale.

hash.description: SHA-256 of everything approved: topic, answer, applies, effective dates, the source text and the account line. An edit after approval makes it differ.

approval.description: Who approved the passage, when, and the hashes of what they approved. Written by pnpm kb:approve.

translates.description: For a passage in another locale, the default-locale passage it translates (same topic).
